question: What practical lessons does Tom Conrad draw from Pets.com for founders building a business?
expected_points: Too much funding can fuel irrational spending and unwinnable competitive arms races.
Consider whether market conditions and infrastructure are ready for the business.
If further funding is unavailable and profitability is out of reach, winding down early may be better than spending every last dollar.
evidence_quote: having an excess of investment can be its own albatross or lead you to make decisions that maybe would be unwise.
